propositions: The retired LLM re-review trigger word 'recheck-review' collides with substring-based CI ChatOps matcher in lfit/releng-gerrit_to_platform, causing spurious Verified -1 cancellations of in-flight CI runs.
The bot's own reply texts embed the retired trigger word verbatim, making each posted comment a live source of spurious CI dispatch.
New trigger token 'rerun-llm-review' contains no mapping key from gerrit_to_platform.ini.template as substring and is wholly disjoint from all ini keys.

The retired word handler posts a refusal reply (after project guard and change re-anchoring) without enqueuing a review or writing labels, and all bot-posted text must omit every ini-mapped trigger word.

All occurrences of the retired word outside the detector module are replaced with the new word in docs, guides, and runbooks; the old word survives only in retrigger.py module and its corresponding test file.
